name: file-tree
title: File tree
description: A virtualised file tree over @boring/files mounts. Expand, select and filter are local; create, rename and remove go through the provider's conditions and return receipts. Its tools (tree_*) are the agent's too.
docs: Needs @boring/viewers and @boring/files in your package.json. Tools: tree_expand, tree_collapse, tree_select, tree_filter, tree_list, tree_create, tree_rename, tree_remove.
